sequential_dependency.intermediate: The ordered subsequent runs and the input-derived selected index (k-1) modulo their count.
sequential_dependency.step_a: Trace the complete four-neighbor path from its reading-order-first endpoint and segment consecutive color runs; measure the first run length k.
sequential_dependency.step_b: Retrieve that selected run from the traced order and emit its color once per run cell as a vertical column.
sequential_dependency.why_b_depends_on_a: Spatial reading order and global color counts lose path order and separate repeated-color runs. The selected run cannot be chosen until tracing supplies both k and the ordered candidates; an off-by-one intermediate selects a different run.
